_purpose: Web page-shortcut registry (infinite-of-x, v0.937.2): was a hardcoded KEYBIND_DEFS array in web/pages/settings-app.js - and until v0.937.2 NOTHING executed the stored bindings (the panel captured shortcuts that did nothing). Now: the Settings > Keybindings panel renders this file, users rebind per-browser (localStorage hos_keybinds_v1), and shell.js dispatches matches globally - a nav bind navigates to its href. Add a shortcut by adding a row (id must stay stable; href is where it goes). Entries for pages that were deleted in the 2026-07-05 trim (dashboard, equipment, logbook, vault) were removed; skills points at /profile where skills live. Chat-internal shortcuts (search, command palette) return as their own group once the chat app implements them - listing bindings that do nothing is exactly what this migration fixed. This registry is web-only by design: the native app's data/keymaps.ron is a different thing (the F1 game-controls reference card), not a rebindable page-shortcut table.
